subject: Terms alignment & kickoff slot pairing for integration
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@oceanside.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Terms alignment & kickoff slot pairing for integration

Jacob —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. OceanSide.ai and our product/ops teams are aligned on next steps; we'd like to run a short combined cycle to (1) walk the MSA redlines with legal/procurement and (2) kick off the technical onboarding checklist so your engineers and ours can align on integration milestones.

Proposed approach: two back-to-back 30-minute blocks on the same day (keeps calendars tidy):
- Block A (Legal/Commercial): 30 min — MSA redline walk through + procurement Qs
- Block B (Onboarding): 30 min — access, SSO/SAML, API keys, initial load test window.

Three window options (PT):
- Wed Apr 11 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu Apr 12 — 14:00–15:00
- Fri Apr 13 — 09:00–10:00

Attached is a short agenda for the legal block and our current MSA draft (redwood-msa-draft-v3.pdf). If procurement from your side (or Lumenicorp, who I understand will be funding the pilot) needs to join, please loop them in and flag preferred times.

If you'd rather have us split into separate days for legal vs onboarding, we can do that — just let us know which you prefer.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: MSA-redline-agenda.pdf
From: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@oceanside.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@lumenicorp.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Terms alignment & kickoff slot pairing for integration

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan. Lumenicorp procurement (cc'd) does want to be on the legal block. Quick heads up: their lead is on the East Coast and prefers late-morning PT or early afternoon PT.

Of your three options, Thu Apr 12 14:00–15:00 PT works best for OceanSide and Lumenicorp. If possible, can we split the sessions and have the legal 14:00–14:30 and the onboarding 14:30–15:00? That way the procurement folks can drop after the legal portion.

Also attaching a short summary of our proposed redlines so your team can pre-scan (OceanSide-redlines-summary.pdf). We're mostly focused on indemnity carveouts, data residency language, and logging retention duration.

Jacob

jacob.lee@oceanside.ai

Thanks Jacob — that split makes sense to me. Quick internal notes:
- Legal team (me + Marissa) will handle the 14:00–14:30 redline session. We'll have our counsel on standby for the indemnity and logging items.
- Onboarding session (14:30–15:00) should include one devEng and one infra lead from each side; Marissa will lead the access checklist.

Naomi — please send calendar invites with separate blocks and include the ICS. Also, do we want to surface the DocuSign link for the current MSA draft in the legal invite so procurement can pre-review?

Onwards —
Markus
VP, Legal & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Confirmed: Thu Apr 12 — Legal 14:00–14:30 PT / Onboarding 14:30–15:00 PT (split invites)

All —

Confirmed for Thu Apr 12. I've split the invites as discussed and attached the calendar file for both blocks (calendar-invite.ics). Quick logistics and next steps:

Legal (14:00–14:30 PT)
- Agenda: quick intro, go through OceanSide-redlines-summary.pdf, flag any deal blockers, agree on open items and owners.
- Please review redwood-msa-draft-v3.pdf before the call. If procurement wants changes captured ahead of time, add comments to the linked doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q2w3eMSA-kickoff-notes
- DocuSign: I will include a viewing link in the invite so procurement can pre-read (not requesting signature yet).

Onboarding (14:30–15:00 PT)
- Agenda: SSO/SCIM, API keys & rate limit expectations, initial load test window + success criteria.
- Suggested attendees: one infra lead from OceanSide, one dev lead from Redwood, plus Marissa to run access steps.

Attachments added to invites: calendar-invite.ics, redwood-msa-draft-v3.pdf.

See you Thursday — and Jacob, thanks for looping procurement. If anything changes on your side, flag here and I'll reshuffle.

Best,
